Looking at the test: they have fields annotated with @Mock: JsonSchema mockParentSchema; ValidatorTypeCode mockValidatorType; ValidationContext mockValidationContext; Set<ValidationMessage> expectedSet; Set<ValidationMessage> dummyReturnSet (also @Mock). So we can remove @Mock annotations and import statements for Mockito.

Also remove @Mock annotations from fields.

Also adjust any leftover imports.

Actually protected members are accessible within subclass, but atRoot() may be protected method; subclass can call it. Now after removing Mockito, compile.
